decisions.reason: The existing message-595 MODIFY already captures both the exclusion of secondary-market sales and registration of randomly assigned tickets.
The existing message-595 MODIFY already captures one accounted commission per primary mint, exclusion of secondary-market sales, and registration of randomly issued commissions.
The source establishes accounting behavior but does not necessarily require an FAQ copy change; the existing no-referral allocation copy remains valid.
Excluding secondary-market sales from commission and ticket counts does not alter the enabled flat royalty or its marketplace enforcement.
The accounting rule does not change which NFT entitlements, badges, referral identity, or existing ticket state transfer on resale.
Commission and ticket accounting does not change the unlimited-mint NFT ebook collection model.
The source does not affect NFT-detail cover visibility or sizing.
The source does not alter the View Book action label or owner-only visibility rule.
The existing message-595 MODIFY already confirms that successful no-referral or invalid-referral primary mints generate a randomly allocated Small Block ticket.
The commission and ticket count rule does not change which successfully minted NFTs the connected user's dashboard must display.
The source uses primary mints as the accounting basis but does not change the existing rule that public mint statistics reflect successful mints.
Excluding secondary-market sales from commission and ticket issuance does not entail removing their existing role in funding or triggering the Small Block prize pool.
